stops.note: 'wet nurse', probably from the nursery word amma 'mother' found in Medieval Latin; Portuguese families in Macau used it for local nursemaids
used across British East Asia; from the 1930s many Hong Kong amahs were 'majie', sworn spinsters from Shunde's silk districts who moved into domestic service after the silk industry collapsed

current_meaning: a nursemaid or domestic servant in East or South Asia
